approvals.quote: If you and the Synapse lane agree we're ready to cut over to Synapse, do it!
approvals.approving: A 24h PILOT, not the cutover, on the lanes synapse, agentlife and overmind only: if the screen contains verbatim "WARNING: Loading development channels" and "I am using this for local development", and Channels is exactly "server:claude-peers, server:synapse" (comma and one space, as the real dialog showed on 2026-10-09), press 1 then Enter (no trailing newline); expires 2026-10-31. Anything else means no answer. PM reading of the quote: on 2026-10-15/16 the PM and the Synapse lane agreed the cutover is NOT ready and a 24h side-by-side pilot comes first (synapse docs/CUTOVER_READINESS_2026-10-15.md), so the quote's condition (agreeing we are ready to cut over) is not met; this record covers the pilot only, the quote is the PM's relay and was not independently verified by the OverMind lane, and it takes effect only if CireSnave merges it.
